facts.fact: USAID's National HMIS Program, per its IATI record, committed US$18,534,492 over 2015-2021 (US$20,804,957 disbursed) to support the AfyaInfo platform and strengthen collection, analysis and use of health data across Kenya's public health system; the record names no domestic funding.

systems.tiers: across Kenya's public health system, tiers not given
